name: Schedule It
description: Schedule it - A software tool which helps you schedule your resources, teams, equipment, rooms, and projects all in one place.

events.d: Retrieve a paginated list of labels (name, color, owner). Choose page number and page size.

events.n: When a new event is created or updated
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically whenever a new event is created or updated in the account.
Retrieve resources with optional filters, selectable fields, and pagination.
List groups with optional ID, name, or modified-date filters and pagination.

Create a scheduled event by specifying a title, owner (resource), and start and end date/time. Optionally add location, notes, priority, completion status, text/background colors, an icon, and up to nine custom fields.
Create a resource and set name, email, owner, skills, location, color settings, and custom fields.
List label groups (ID and name). Supports page number and page size pagination.
Create a scheduling group and set name, color, position, resource limits, and visibility options.
Delete an existing event by its ID.
Delete a selected resource using its ID.
